svg.text: La Pischina / native map 912: four arenas and optional annex
Exact XYZ graph; colors follow native PositionTrigger cuts. XY diagram overlaps elevation layers.
Red: Door objects. Door 31487 leads from room 3 into the gray optional annex.
Four annex doors at z=-4 project onto terrain z=-5: footprint hypothesis, not decoded collision authority.
Blue: literal exterior transporters 24196 (entry) and 24197 (boss arena). Gold: annex chest.
All four arenas accommodate six players and eight enemies with native combat geometry.
